concerns.text: Task T005 requires fetching 30‑day historical calibration snapshots for all public backends. The IBM Quantum API (`IBMQBackend.properties()` or similar) only returns the *current* snapshot; it does not provide a historical archive of past calibration data. Consequently, implementing a reliable fetch of past snapshots is impossible without an external data store, which is not specified in the spec or plan. This makes T005 unexecutable as written.
